See design doc for full rationale and three-layer history model.

uam-forward-subagent-actions.title: Forward subagent action events to parent stream (Design C-minimal)
uam-forward-subagent-actions.description: Modify SubAgentRunner.bridgeEvent (line 153-172): forward ActionProposed and ActionExecuted to the parent's eventEmitter unchanged, instead of wrapping them as SubAgentActivity. Pass parentEventEmitter into IsolatedSubAgentRunner's constructor from SessionAgentRunner.ensureDelegationToolRegistered (line 152-166). All other events (ThoughtUpdate, MessageDelta, TurnPhaseChanged, ScreenCaptured) stay on the existing SubAgentActivity bridge or are dropped. UUID-keyed actionIds prevent collisions in ChatEventReducer and AgentMessageBuffer; no schema change required. Out of scope: originAgent label on ContentBlockRecord.Action (defer until UX feedback). Fallback to Design A (no change to bridgeEvent) only if rewiring parentEventEmitter to IsolatedSubAgentRunner's construction site turns out to be unexpectedly tangled.
acceptCriteria: SubAgentRunner.bridgeEvent forwards ActionProposed and ActionExecuted to parentEventEmitter without SubAgentActivity wrapping
